guide.jj_giants.title: Giants Guide
guide.jj_giants.together.one: Only one giant is installed, so he has nobody to meet.
guide.jj_giants.none: None of JJ's giants are installed. Put the all-in-one jar (or the giants' own jars) in your mods folder.
guide.jj_giants.tier_note.light: Quick, and he uses them a lot.
guide.jj_giants.tier_note.medium: A short warning, then a hard hit.
guide.jj_giants.tier_note.heavy: Rare and huge. A loud warning and a red message come first, so get away. After one he's worn out for a few seconds.
guide.jj_giants.live.title: Right now, in this world
guide.jj_giants.live.no_server: This server doesn't have the Giants Guide, so it can't say. Try /giants where.
guide.jj_giants.live.nothing: The server says nothing about him.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.name: Pitchgut
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.size: About 265 blocks long and 185 tall at full size. 6,000 health.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.about.2: A walking mountain of goo, flesh and eyes. He walks mouth first on 39 legs, leaves a trail of black goo, and breathes in everything near his mouth. You can climb onto his back, but about 70 arms up there grab you.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.about.3: He's the juggernaut: the toughest of the giants, and his heavy moves are the biggest. He's slow, about 5 blocks a second (7 when he's hunting).
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.about.5: | Calm | wanders and leaves you alone until you hit him or stand in front of his mouth
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.about.6: | Hunting | comes for the nearest player
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.about.7: | Guardian | goes after monsters and leaves players, villagers and animals alone
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.about.8: He sleeps. The world's own one is lying asleep in his den when you find him. A hit wakes him at once.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.about.9: Spawn eggs (creative): Calm, Hunting, Guardian and Small. Sizes from 0.03 to 2 work.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.about.10: He heals very slowly on his own: 1% of his health a minute, and nothing for 15 seconds after any hurt, so in a fight it hardly counts.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.where.2: His own biome, about 900 blocks out from where he gets up. Low mounds and long valleys of tuff, stone and dark ground, rib cages, breath vents, goo springs, boulders and cracked earth. In the middle is his den: a crater with a lake of goo and a huge skull.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.where.3: There is one in a world, 3,000 to 15,000 blocks from spawn. /locate biome mountain_breathes:goo_barrens finds it.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.where.5: Make a Finder of Pitchgut and right-click it. It says in chat which way he is and how far, like this: "Pitchgut is 3200 blocks north-east of you, at 9095, 6569, in the Goo Barrens." It glints while he's within 300 blocks. It works in the overworld.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.where.8: | Natural spawning | On to start with. The world keeps one of him out there, asleep in his den. /pitchgut natural off stops it.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.where.9: | How many at once | 1 to start with (the world cap). /pitchgut limit changes it, 0 for no limit. Past it, the oldest one goes.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.where.10: | After he dies | The next one gets up about 10 days later, a long way off, with new ground. The old ground stays.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.moves.1: Above half health he only picks a heavy move a minute or more into a fight, and then about once a minute.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.fight.2: | His eyes | full damage, and a popped eye stays dark. His flesh only takes a tenth.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.fight.3: | His mouth | six times the damage while his face is open. Shoot into it.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.fight.4: | His legs | break enough of them and he comes down on his belly, where he takes more damage. At about seven legs in ten he never stands again.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.fight.5: | His heart | inside him: three times the damage. Hurt it enough and he coughs you back out.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.fight.7: - His goo slows you and darkens your screen. Keep out of his trail.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.fight.8: - A wall between you and his mouth keeps his breath off you.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.fight.9: - Inside him, stand on the raised mounds. The goo floor burns. Kill the leeches quickly.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.fight.10: - When a red message comes up, run, or get behind something solid. Right after a heavy move he is worn out for five seconds: hit him then.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.fight.11: - His heart (from his loot) holds him off your base for 20 minutes at a time.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.fight.12: - Use a render distance of 10 or more for the full-size one.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.drops.1: Everything goes into a Loot Cache on a shrine beside where he fell, with a beam of light over it.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.drops.2: @item mountain_breathes:goo_maw |  | His weapon. Use it: his tongue lashes out 18 blocks and reels in what it catches, or pulls you to the ground it hits. Sneak and use: spit a glob of his goo. Every third hit bursts.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.drops.4: @item mountain_breathes:hide_helmet,mountain_breathes:hide_chestplate,mountain_breathes:hide_leggings,mountain_breathes:hide_boots | His hide | Sometimes in his loot. Wear all four: falls don't hurt you, his goo can't slow you, under 6 hearts your skin sets like stone, whatever hits you up close gets goo on it, and you heal in his goo and on the Goo Barrens.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.drops.5: | Armour power (R) | his Breath: draw a deep breath, then blast everything in front of you back. Every 20 seconds.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.drops.6: @item mountain_breathes:mountain_heart |  | The ward. Set it down and knock on it. It beats: everything near that means you harm is thrown off its feet, and for 20 minutes he won't come within 700 blocks of it. Then it sits dark for 20 minutes.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.drops.7: @item mountain_breathes:mountain_flesh,mountain_breathes:mountain_eye,mountain_breathes:mountain_horn,mountain_breathes:goo_bucket | And more | His flesh, his eyes, a Horn of Pitchgut and his goo, with a nether star, diamonds, netherite scrap, bone blocks and crying obsidian.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.drops.8: @item mountain_breathes:mountain_codex |  | His book. Hold it and he is yours: he won't hunt you, and it gives him orders.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.drops.9: "Kill what I look at" in his book sends him after what's under your crosshair, up to 512 blocks off, even when he is far away or out of sight. A part of another giant counts as that giant. Only you see it glow. He keeps at it until it dies, it's lost for 30 seconds or you give a new order.

guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.name: Furrowmaw
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.size: About 600 blocks long at full size. 6,000 health.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.about.2: A blind, ringed burrower. He swims through the ground with his legs folded flat, and crawls on top on a pair of legs per ring. He has no eyes: everything he knows comes up through the ground.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.about.3: He's the ambusher: fast under the ground and deep down where almost nothing reaches him, but he has to come up to hurt anything, and he's soft when he's up.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.about.5: Walking, running, jumping, breaking and placing blocks, fighting and explosions all reach him. Sneaking makes no sound. Stand still or sneak and he loses you. A Hush Bristle in your off hand hides everything you do.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.about.6: You can see where he is under the ground: the ground over his head heaves and spits dirt.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.about.8: | Calm | leaves you alone unless you hit him
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.about.9: | Hunting | goes after anything he can feel moving
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.about.10: | Guardian | stays round the spot he came up and hunts anything near it
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.about.11: The world's own one sleeps far from spawn until somebody finds him. Spawn eggs (creative): Calm, Hunting, Guardian and Small, and a Furrowling egg.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.about.12: He heals very slowly on his own: 1% of his health a minute, and nothing for 15 seconds after any hurt, so in a fight it hardly counts.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.where.2: His own biome, about 1,800 blocks across. Long furrows all running the same way with magma glowing along their bottoms, husks he shed, sinkholes, burrows, bone spurs, red sand dunes, and his spiral den in the middle. The air is dusty orange with ash in it, and nothing else spawns there.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.where.3: There is one in a world, 3,000 to 15,000 blocks from spawn. /locate biome furrowmaw:furrowed_waste finds it.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.where.5: Make a Finder of Furrowmaw and right-click it. It says in chat which way he is and how far, like this: "Furrowmaw is 3200 blocks north-east of you, at 9095, 6569, in the Furrowed Waste." It glints while he's within 300 blocks. It works in the overworld.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.where.8: | Natural spawning | On to start with. The world keeps one of him out there, asleep in his ground. /furrowmaw natural off stops it.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.where.9: | How many at once | 1 to start with (the world cap). /furrowmaw limit changes it, 0 for no limit. Past it, the oldest one goes.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.where.10: | After he dies | The next one rises about 10 days later, a long way off, with new ground. The old ground stays.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.moves.1: When he hears something he can't place, he rears up partway and listens.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.fight.3: | His rings | half damage. They are armoured shells.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.fight.4: | Inside his head | two and a half times the damage. After enough hits he spits you out.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.fight.7: - At two thirds and one third health, six rings tear off the back of him and turn into Furrowlings, small ring crawlers that bite.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.fight.8: - Below half health he gets angry: faster, he hits harder, and his maw spits embers.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.fight.9: - Each player after the first who hurts him adds 30% to his health, up to three times.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.fight.11: - If he is hunting you, sneak. If you need to dig, hold a Hush Bristle in your off hand.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.fight.12: - When the ground heaves under you, move. He is about to come up.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.fight.13: - Get out from in front of him for the great slam, the rupture and the inhale.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.fight.14: - Right after a heavy move he is worn out for five seconds. Hit him then.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.fight.15: - Found him asleep? Walk up quietly and get the first hits in.

guide.jj_giants.cerberus.name: The Cerberus
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.size: About 280 blocks long and 200 tall at full size. Three heads, 2,000 health each.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.about.2: A giant three-headed dog. The left head is fire, the right head is ice and the middle one is stone. Each head has its own health. Bring all three down and he falls.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.about.3: He's the skirmisher: by far the fastest giant. He trots at about 24 blocks a second, gallops at 38 and pounces. His hits are lighter. His speed is his strength.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.about.5: | Calm | wanders and leaves things alone unless they hurt him
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.about.6: | Hunting | goes after players and hostile mobs he sees
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.about.7: | Guardian | stays near where he was spawned and goes after anything that comes close
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.about.8: He sleeps like a wolf after a couple of minutes with nothing going on. A hit wakes him.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.about.9: Spawn eggs (creative): Calm, Hunting, Guardian and Small. Sizes from 0.03 to 2 work.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.about.10: He heals very slowly on his own: 1% of his health a minute, and nothing for 15 seconds after any hurt, so in a fight it hardly counts.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.where.1: # His ground: the Cinder Ground and the Frost Ground
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.where.2: About 1,800 blocks across, cut in two by a wavy line. The Cinder Ground has basalt terraces, crusted flats with magma and ember cracks, ash hills, spires and walled lava pools. The Frost Ground has snow drifts, packed ice, ice spires, frozen boulders and frozen ponds. Where they meet there is a rift with steam vents. His den in the middle is a sunken arena, half obsidian and magma, half ice.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.where.3: There is one in a world, 3,000 to 15,000 blocks from spawn. /locate biome fire_ice_cerberus:cinder_ground finds it.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.where.5: Make a Finder of the Cerberus and right-click it. It says in chat which way he is and how far, like this: "The Cerberus is 3200 blocks north-east of you, at 9095, 6569, in the Cinder Ground and Frost Ground." It glints while he's within 300 blocks. It works in the overworld.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.where.8: | Natural spawning | On to start with. The world keeps one of him out there, in the middle of his den. /cerberus natural off stops it.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.where.9: | How many at once | 1 to start with (the world cap). /cerberus limit changes it, 0 for no limit. Past it, the oldest one goes.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.where.10: | After he dies | The next one gets up about 10 days later, a long way off, with new ground. The old ground stays.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.moves.1: No fire moves once his fire head is down, and no ice moves once his ice head is down.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.fight.2: | A head | hurts that head. When a head goes down it hangs limp and its moves stop.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.fight.3: | A jaw | a bit more than the head.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.fight.4: | His body | all three heads a little.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.fight.6: He can't be hurt by fire, falling, freezing, lightning or being stuck in blocks.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.fight.8: - Once a head is down he's angry: his hits are 10% harder and his moves come round 10% sooner.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.fight.9: - He gets 30% more health for each player past the first who fights him, up to three times.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.fight.11: - Take a head down first. With the fire head gone there is no fire; with the ice head gone, no ice.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.fight.12: - Hit him when he's worn out after a heavy move: he can't do anything for five seconds.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.fight.13: - Asleep, he's an easy target for the first hit. After that he's up.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.fight.14: - His skull keeps him away from your base for 20 minutes at a time.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.drops.1: It all goes in the Loot Cache on the shrine where he falls. A small one (under size 0.5) drops less.

guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.name: The Hollowbell
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.size: About 200 blocks wide and 200 tall at full size. 6,000 health.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.about.2: A huge green jellyfish of glass, copper and bone that swims through the air. He drifts low over the land with his strand ends dragging along the ground. His glass dome is hollow, and what he catches ends up inside it.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.about.3: He's the aerial one: slow (about 5 blocks a second) and middling at everything, but he flies, and he climbs after anything up high. His pods are his weak spots.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.about.4: Touching a strand stings: poison and slowness.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.about.6: | Calm | leaves you alone unless you hit him
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.about.7: | Hunting | goes after any player he can find
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.about.8: | Guardian | stays near the spot he was put down and goes after anything that comes near it
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.about.9: The world's own one comes down out of the sky, calm and full size. Spawn eggs (creative): Calm, Hunting, Guardian and Small, and a Belling egg.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.about.10: He heals very slowly on his own: 1% of his health a minute, and nothing for 15 seconds after any hurt, so in a fight it hardly counts.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.where.2: His own biome, about 900 blocks out from the middle. Pale calcite and bone hills scooped with hollows, mint grass, fallen glass shards, tendril reefs, spore gardens, still pools, spires, fallen ribs and drifting lights, with his great glass bell in the middle.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.where.3: There is one in a world, 3,000 to 15,000 blocks from spawn. /locate biome hollowbell:bell_hollows finds it.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.where.5: Make a Finder of the Hollowbell and right-click it. It says in chat which way he is and how far, like this: "The Hollowbell is 3200 blocks north-east of you, at 9095, 6569, in the Bell Hollows." It glints while he's within 300 blocks. It works in the overworld.

guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.moves.1: Bigger ones hit harder and wider, smaller ones less. Hit the strand or arm that holds you four times and it lets go.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.fight.2: | The crown | (the pale patch on top of his dome) 3 times, 4 from inside.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.fight.3: | The five glowing spots | (under the dome) 2.5 times, 3.5 from inside.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.fight.4: | A pod | full, and the pod pops.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.fight.6: | Dome, rim, arms, strands | very little.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.fight.8: The pods hang among the strands, low enough to reach from the ground. Each popped pod takes 1% of his health. Pop a third of them (8 of 23 at full size) and he sinks right down for at least 30 seconds. While he is down, everything hits him a bit harder. A popped pod starts growing back after 150 seconds.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.fight.10: If a strand pulls you all the way up, you are inside the dome. It hurts in there, but the glowing spots are right over your head: hit them. Hurt him enough from inside and he lets you go.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.fight.12: - Pop the pods first. Watch for the bell squeezing hard: that's the pulse wave. Don't be flying near him.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.fight.13: - When the red message comes up, get well out from under him. Right after a heavy move he is worn out for 5 seconds.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.fight.14: - Bring a bow for the crown and the spots.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.drops.1: All of it goes into his Loot Cache on a pedestal where he fell. Its beam shows from up to 1024 blocks away.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.drops.2: @item hollowbell:stinger |  | His weapon: a whip-like sword, a bit stronger than netherite. What it hits is poisoned and slowed. Hold right-click and let go to throw it like a harpoon: small things are pulled to you, walls and big things pull you to them.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.drops.3: @item hollowbell:bell_glass_helmet,hollowbell:bell_glass_chestplate,hollowbell:bell_glass_leggings,hollowbell:bell_glass_boots | Bell glass armour | Crafted from his Bell Glass. Like diamond, with more toughness. Wear all four: poison and dizziness stay off you, a fast fall turns into a slow drift, and hurt low the glass rings and throws back what is close.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.drops.4: | Armour power (R) | on the ground, float up and slam down, stunning all round. In the air, glide.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.drops.5: @item hollowbell:hollowbell_crown |  | The ward. Set it down, stand within 16 blocks and use /hollowbell ward on (cheats on). For 20 minutes he won't come within 700 blocks of it. Then it sits dark for 20 minutes.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.drops.6: @item hollowbell:bell_glass,hollowbell:hollowbell_pod | And more | Bell Glass and Hollowbell Pods (a pod in a glass bottle makes a poison potion), with oxidized copper, bone blocks and verdant froglight from his body.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.drops.7: @item hollowbell:hollowbell_codex |  | His book. Hold it and he is yours: he leaves you alone and drifts where you point.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.drops.8: "Grab what I look at" in his book sends him after what's under your crosshair, up to 512 blocks off, even when he is far away or out of sight. A part of another giant counts as that giant. Only you see it glow. He keeps at it until it dies, it's lost for 30 seconds or you give a new order.

guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.name: The Lantern Willow
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.size: About 200 blocks wide and 200 tall at full size. 6,000 health.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.about.2: A weeping willow the size of a hill, and he's alive: glowing lures on the ends of his strands, a fish's mouth in his trunk, two great eyes, and roots he pulls out of the ground to walk on.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.about.3: He's the fortress: rooted, he hits the hardest and he's the toughest of them all. Walking, he's slow (under 4 blocks a second) and weaker. Most of the time he stands rooted, looking like a huge glowing willow.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.about.4: At night his lures slowly pull you in toward him. Mudlings crawl up out of the mud and fight for him.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.about.6: | Calm | leaves you alone unless you hit him
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.about.7: | Hunting | goes after any player he can find
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.about.8: | Guardian | stays near the spot he was put down and goes after anything that comes near it
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.about.9: The world's own one waits under the ground in his den and rises when you come. Spawn eggs (creative): Calm, Hunting, Guardian and Small, and a Mudling egg.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.about.10: He heals very slowly on his own: 1% of his health a minute, and nothing for 15 seconds after any hurt, so in a fight it hardly counts. That is the only way he heals: drinking the land, water and rooting don't heal him.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.where.2: His own biome, about 900 blocks out from the middle. Mud and moss and mangrove roots, with mangroves and swamp oaks, winding channels and pools of teal water, lantern posts and arches, root tangles, sunk boats, reeds and blue-green fog. In the middle is his den: a dark pool with an island of lanterns, ringed by eight huge dead stumps.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.where.3: There is one in a world, 3,000 to 15,000 blocks from spawn, in a swamp or a wood if it can. /locate biome lanternwillow:lantern_marsh finds it once you are within about 6,000 blocks.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.where.5: Make a Finder of the Lantern Willow and right-click it. It says in chat which way he is and how far, like this: "The Lantern Willow is 3200 blocks north-east of you, at 9095, 6569, in the Lantern Marsh." It glints while he's within 300 blocks. It works in the overworld.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.where.8: | Natural spawning | On to start with. The world keeps one of him out there, waiting in his den. /lanternwillow natural off stops it.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.where.9: | How many at once | 1 to start with (the world cap). /lanternwillow limit changes it, 0 for no limit. Past it, the oldest one goes.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.where.10: | After he dies | The next one rises about 10 days later, a long way off, with new ground. The old ground stays.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.moves.1: Rooted, every hit lands a quarter harder. The ones marked "Rooted only" need his roots in the ground.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.fight.3: | Inside his throat | 3 times. Hurt him enough from inside and he spits you out.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.fight.4: | The small eyes in his branches | 2 times.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.fight.6: | A lure | full, and the lure breaks.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.fight.7: | Bark, roots, strands, leaves | very little.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.fight.8: While he is rooted, hits on his weak spots count a bit less (0.8 times). He is wood: fire hurts him more.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.fight.10: Lures hang on the ends of his strands, many low enough to reach. Break about a sixth of them (45 at full size) and he goes dim for at least 30 seconds: no lure moves, no pull, and everything hits him 30% harder. A broken lure grows back after about 2.5 minutes.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.fight.12: - Break lures to make him go dim, then hit hard.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.fight.13: - When the red message comes up, get away. For the root quake, jump as each ring reaches you.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.fight.14: - Hide behind something solid for the lantern nova.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.fight.15: - Right after a heavy move he is worn out for a few seconds. Hit him then.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.drops.1: His loot is in the Loot Cache on a small shrine where he falls. Its beam shows from up to 1024 blocks away.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.drops.2: @item lanternwillow:root_maul |  | His weapon: a heavy club, stronger than netherite but slow. What it hits is slowed and weakened. Right-click to slam it down: a ring of roots rolls out round you and throws up what it reaches. Every 12 seconds.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.drops.3: @item lanternwillow:heartwood_helmet,lanternwillow:heartwood_chestplate,lanternwillow:heartwood_leggings,lanternwillow:heartwood_boots | Heartwood armour | Crafted from his Willow Heartwood. Like diamond, with a bit less knockback. Wear all four: you heal slowly standing on grass, dirt, mud, moss or roots, his drink can't slow or starve you, his lures can't pull you in, you see in the dark, and crops and saplings near you grow faster.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.drops.4: | Armour power (R) | roots burst up under everything near you, hold it, and heal you from it. Every 20 seconds.

guide.jj_giants.together.meetings.1: When two of JJ's giants come near each other out in the world, they fight or keep away. It's the same in every giant's mod.
guide.jj_giants.together.meetings.3: - They only meet when both are free: awake, not under an order, not after anybody, not ridden and not told to stay.
guide.jj_giants.together.meetings.4: - They notice each other within 160 blocks times their size (always 48 to 320 blocks).
guide.jj_giants.together.meetings.5: - A fight ends when one drops under a quarter of its health. That one backs down: it runs off for a minute, and no giant fights it for two minutes.
guide.jj_giants.together.meetings.6: - One keeping away still hits back if it is attacked.
guide.jj_giants.together.meetings.7: - The same two don't fight again for 10 minutes.
guide.jj_giants.together.meetings.8: - Everyone within 256 blocks gets a chat message when a fight starts and when it ends.
guide.jj_giants.together.meetings.10: | /giants meetings on/off | whether they fight or keep away when they meet

guide.jj_giants.together.giants.23: You can also craft one from a book and a compass. Everyone gets one the first time they join a world.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.goo_lob.wh: He tips his head back and lobs lumps of goo high over, to come down on and around you.
One of his legs swings out sideways and sweeps across the ground through where you stand.
The hands on his back rise together and slam down on whoever is up there.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.darts.what: The holes in his skin nearest you spit fast poison darts.
One of his walking legs lifts high over you and stamps down.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.gaze.what: Every eye turns on you and stands your own shadow up out of the goo. It lasts while he can see you.
He rears his front end up into the sky and drops it. A shock ring runs out along the ground.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.vomit.what: His face splits wide and a flood of goo pours out over the ground in front of him.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.tentacle_e: Something burrows from under his mouth to where you are, and tentacles burst up round you.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.loose_eyes: He tears a few eyes loose and flings them at you. They hang in the air and spit goo.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.scream.wha: He screams. A wall of sound rolls out in front of him, throws you back and darkens the world.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.tongue.wha: A long tongue shoots out at you. If it catches you it reels you back into his mouth.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.belly_crus: He drops his whole body flat on whatever is under his belly or his jaw, then heaves himself back up.
He throws his head up and hoses the whole place down with goo for several seconds.
Every eye he has left finds something of its own, and they all burn at once.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.draw_in.wh: He breathes in for about fifteen seconds. Everything loose near him is dragged toward his mouth.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.tear_off.w: He pulls a lump of himself out of his side, and it stands up and fights beside him for a while.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.quake.what: He rears up higher than ever and comes down hard. Three shock waves roll out along the ground.
guide.jj_giants.pitchgut.move.tentacle_f: He drives his arms into the ground and rings of tentacles burst up round you and round him.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.bite.what: A quick lunge and snap of the mandibles at what's right in front of the maw. Leaves it withering.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.spit.what: He rears and lobs lumps of magma. They splash, set things alight and slow them.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.tail_flic: The tail curls over his back and flings lumps of ground. Only once his tail is out.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.dust.what: A cloud of dirt round his head: blinds and slows, and he slips away under the ground.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.slam.what: The front of him rises, sways, and crashes down in front of him.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.swallow.w: He rears with his mandibles wide and comes down on what's in front of him, swallowing it.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.charge.wh: Head down, he comes at it at three times his crawling speed and flings what he hits.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.shriek.wh: A scream from the maw: shoves back and blinds what's near, and makes everything in his hearing glow.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.vent.what: He arches and the cracks on his rings spit magma straight up, to rain down round him.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.tail_whip: The tail lifts and lashes sideways, flinging what it catches a long way. Only once his tail is out.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.tremor.wh: He presses flat and a ring of broken ground runs out from him, throwing up what stands on it.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.thrash.wh: He whips his whole length side to side.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.coil.what: He crawls round it in a circle, pulls the ring tight, drags it to the middle and squeezes.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.breach.wh: From under the ground he bursts straight up where he is, throwing everything near into the air.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.roll.what: He throws his whole length over sideways, crushing everything under his rings.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.erupt.wha: He rears, opens the maw wide and sweeps a stream of magma across the ground in front of him.
He goes under where you're looking, the ground falls in, and he bursts up out of the bottom.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.great_sla: His whole front half goes up and comes down flat in a long line, crushing everything along it.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.magma_sto: Every ring spits magma high into the air for five seconds, raining down all along him.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.rupture.w: He drives his maw into the ground and it blows open in a line in front of him, blast after blast.
guide.jj_giants.furrowmaw.move.inhale.wh: He opens wide and breathes in, dragging everything in front of him into his maw.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.bite.what: The nearest head lunges and bites. The fire head burns, the ice head freezes.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.swipe.what: One front paw swings out sideways and knocks away what it hits.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.tail_sweep: His tail swings round to hit what's behind or beside him.
The fire head spits a string of fireballs. Good for things far off or up high.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.shake.what: He shakes himself like a wet dog. Sparks and frost fly off, burning and freezing what's close.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.flame_brea: The fire head breathes a long stream of fire at it. Sets things alight and burns the ground.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.frost_brea: The ice head breathes freezing air at it. Slows and freezes what it catches and leaves snow.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.ice_spikes: A line of ice spikes bursts out of the ground toward the target, with a ring round it.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.boulder.wh: The stone head throws a lump of blackstone in a high arc. It smashes where it lands.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.stomp.what: He lifts both front paws and brings them down. The ground bursts under them.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.roar.what: All three heads roar. Shoves back and weakens everything near him.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.cinder_rai: The fire head coughs burning cinders into the sky. They rain down round the target.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.hail.what: The ice head throws hail into the sky. It rains down round the target.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.howl.what: All three heads howl. Everything near him is slowed, half blinded, and glows.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.pounce.wha: He crouches and leaps at the target, landing hard on everything under him.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.charge.wha: Heads down, he runs straight at it, trampling and throwing everything in his way.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.twin_breat: Fire and ice heads breathe at once. Where they meet it bursts into scalding steam.
The fire head howls at the sky, then pillars of fire burst up in a ring that closes in on the target.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.frost_nova: He crouches, the ice head breathes in, and three rings of ice spikes burst out all round him.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.frenzy.wha: He lunges forward biting with all three heads in turn, again and again.
guide.jj_giants.cerberus.move.quake_slam: He rears up on his hind legs and slams down. A shock wave rolls out along the ground and throws everything up.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.grab.wha: A strand takes what you look at and pulls it up into the dome.
A strand pulls up a creature or a tree under him.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.sting_vo: The strand ends nearest you flick three rounds of stingers at you. Poison and slowness.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.strand_l: One strand winds back and whips sideways through everything on that side of him.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.glow_fla: Every glowing part flares at once: blindness and darkness, and far worse at night.
The strands close in round what you look at and pull tight.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.sweep.wh: All the strands swing across the ground.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.arm_slam: An arm lifts and slaps down.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.arm_wrap: An arm curls round what you look at and squeezes.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.pulse_wa: A hard pulse: a shock ring, knockback and nausea, and flyers fall.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.shed.wha: Egg clumps drop off and hatch into Bellings.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.spore_cl: Egg clumps burst into clouds of poison that drift after you.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.pod_burs: Every pod swells and sprays poison goo straight down.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.egg_rain: Egg clumps drop off and burst where they land. Some hatch into Bellings.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.drop.wha: The bell lifts and glows, then the whole of him comes down on the ground. A huge blow round him.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.whirlpoo: He spins, and his strands drag everything in a wide ring in under him, then crush it.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.sky_dive: He climbs very high, turns over and dives bell first. A huge shock wave where he lands.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.deep_tol: Three tolls, louder each time, then a massive shock ring. Throws everything far and breaks glass and leaves.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.arm_stor: All eight arms go up, then crash down one after another all round him.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.stinger_: Every strand flicks stingers up, and they rain down over a wide area.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.sun_lanc: A beam of burning light from each glowing spot sweeps out over the ground. One hunts you.
guide.jj_giants.hollowbell.move.undertow: His strands spread wide and drag everything round him in, then slam it down.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.stran: One strand winds back and whips at what you look at.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.root_: A root tears up out of the ground and stabs down on it.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.mud_s: He spits a ball of mud from his mouth. It slows what it hits.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.lure_: The angler lure flares. Whatever looks at it is pulled toward his mouth.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.eye_f: His big eyes flare: blindness, darkness and slowness for whatever faces him.
His jaw snaps at whatever is right in front of his mouth.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.swall: He pulls it in and swallows it. From inside you can fight your way out.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.stran: His strands sweep across the ground in front of him and throw things aside.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.root_: Up on his roots, he lifts one high and stamps it down. Needs him up out of the ground.
Roots burst up round it and hold it in place for a few seconds.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.lante: The lures nearest it flare and burst with light and heat: a hard hit, fire and blindness.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.call_: Mudlings crawl up out of the mud and fight for him.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.bog.w: The ground round him turns to sucking mud. Everything in it slows down.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.seed_: The canopy shakes out a cloud of seeds: nausea, slowness and poison.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.weepi: Every strand comes down again and again all round him.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.uproo: He rears up on his roots and slams the whole of himself down. A huge blow round him.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.devou: His mouth opens wide and pulls in everything in front of him, then shuts.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.root_: Roots burst up under everything in reach and all over the ground round him.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.lante: Every lure swells, then all flare at once. Hide behind something solid.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.limb_: His great limbs lift, then crash down all round him. It hurts where the strands hit the ground.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.root_: Rooted only. He grips the ground and three rings of roots burst out from him. Jump as a ring reaches you.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.drink: Rooted only. He drinks the life out of the ground round him. It hurts, slows and starves you. It never heals him.
guide.jj_giants.lanternwillow.move.pull_: Rooted only. Roots grab it and drag it along the ground to his mouth, and he bites down.
guide.jj_giants.tier_note.sea: Only in deep water (about 6 deep at full size). A long warning and a line in chat come first. After one he is worn out for a long time, and he never does two in a row.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.name: Wreckback
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.size: About 323 blocks long and 208 tall at full size. 6,000 health.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.about.2: A hermit crab the size of a ship, and the shell on his back is a wrecked three-masted galleon. Eyes on stalks and more eyes in the planks, feelers pouring out of the hull, two big claws and an anchor on a chain.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.about.3: He's the warship: his ship has guns, a bell and an anchor, and every piece of it can be broken off. He lives in the sea and comes ashore. In deep water his moves hit 1.3 times harder and he slowly heals.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.about.4: All of him is solid: his claws, legs, body, shell, eyes, feelers, the ship, its masts, guns and anchor. You can stand on any part of him and ride it: you move with him as he walks, turns and rocks. Only the kelp, the sails and the roots of his feelers push you aside. If he moves into you, you are put out beside him unhurt.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.about.5: Climb the rope nets on his sides (a rope's end hangs down under each ladder, so you can climb on from the ground) or the anchor chain. The open hatches drop you into his hold, onto his soft body.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.about.6: Giants don't go through him. When he fights another giant, or walks into one, their bodies stay apart and the blows land on its side.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.about.8: | Calm | leaves you alone unless you hit him
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.about.9: | Hunting | goes after any player he can find, and hostile mobs too
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.about.10: | Guardian | stays near where he was put down and goes after anything that comes near it
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.about.11: The world's own one waits under the sea in front of his den and rises up out of the water when you come. Spawn eggs (creative): Calm, Hunting, Guardian and Small, and a Drowned Crewman egg for one of his crew.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.about.12: He heals very slowly on his own: 1% of his health a minute (2% in deep water), and nothing for 15 seconds after any hurt, so in a fight it hardly counts.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.where.2: His own biome, about 900 blocks out from the middle. Warm shallow water and sandbars, a wide beach with dunes, kelp and coral, the ribs of old wrecks and broken masts sticking out of the water, half-sunk chests (empty), old piers and rowboats. In the middle is his den: a huge sea cliff with a cave in it big enough for him.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.where.3: There is one in a world, 3,000 to 15,000 blocks from spawn, on a coast. /locate biome wreckback:wreck_shallows finds it.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.where.5: Make a Finder of Wreckback and right-click it. It says in chat which way he is and how far, like this: "Wreckback is 3200 blocks north-east of you, at 9095, 6569, in the Wreck Shallows."
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.where.8: | Natural spawning | On to start with. The world keeps one of him out there, waiting under the sea by his den. /wreckback natural off stops it.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.where.9: | How many at once | 1 to start with (the world cap). /wreckback limit changes it, 0 for no limit. Past it, the oldest one goes.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.where.10: | After he dies | The next one comes about 10 days later, a long way off, with new ground. The old ground stays.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.moves.1: In deep water every move hits 1.3 times harder. Moves that need a piece of his ship (guns, the bell, the anchor, the mainmast) stop once that piece is broken off.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.fight.2: | His soft body (inside the hull) | 1.5 times.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.fight.3: | His mouth, when it's open | 1.5 times.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.fight.4: | His eyes | 1.3 times, and he flinches and loses the move he was winding up.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.fight.7: | His ship (hull, decks, masts, guns, anchor) | a quarter, and it wears that piece down.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.fight.9: Every piece of the ship has its own health and falls off when it breaks: no guns, no broadside; no anchor, no anchor swing. A broken hull section shows the soft body under it.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.fight.10: Hurt badly he pulls into his shell, and hits from outside do almost nothing. Get inside the hull and hit his soft body three times to drive him out.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.fight.11: With every hull section gone he is stripped: he takes 1.8 times the damage and runs for the sea, where his hull grows back. That can happen twice in a fight.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.fight.13: - Fight him on land. In deep water he hits harder, heals and has his sea moves.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.fight.14: - Break his guns early. Then he has no broadsides or barrages.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.fight.15: - When the red message comes up, get away. Right after a heavy or sea move he is worn out: hit him then.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.drops.1: His loot goes into a Loot Cache on a little sunken altar where he falls. Its sea-green beam shows from up to 1024 blocks away.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.drops.2: @item wreckback:anchor_hook |  | His weapon: a sword of black iron on a chain, stronger than netherite. What it hits is slowed. Right-click throws it: it hooks a block and hauls you there, or hooks a creature and drags it to you.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.drops.3: @item wreckback:shell_helmet,wreckback:shell_chestplate,wreckback:shell_leggings,wreckback:shell_boots | Shell armour | Made from his Shell Plates. As tough as diamond. Full set: sometimes a hit only knocks a plate off you, and you breathe under water and swim fast.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.drops.4: | Armour power (R) | Into the shell: you pull in for 4 seconds, can't move and take almost nothing, then burst out and throw everything round you back. Every 20 seconds.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.drops.5: @item wreckback:captains_bell |  | The ward. Set it down, stand within 16 blocks and use /wreckback ward on (cheats on). For 20 minutes he won't come near it.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.drops.6: @item wreckback:shell_plate,wreckback:barnacle_block | And more | Shell Plates, a Heart of the Sea, nautilus shells, prismarine shards, barnacle blocks and wet planks.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.drops.7: @item wreckback:wreckback_codex |  | His book. Hold it and he is yours: he leaves you alone and walks where you point.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.drops.8: "Go after what I look at" in his book sends him after what's under your crosshair, up to 512 blocks off, even when he is far away or out of sight. A part of another giant counts as that giant. Only you see it glow. He keeps at it until it dies, it's lost for 30 seconds or you give a new order.

guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.claw_snip: A quick pinch with his small claw at what's in front of him.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.feeler_la: Three feelers rear up over his deck and whip down onto the ground.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.barnacle_: He spits clumps of barnacles that stick: they slow you and hurt a little.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.claw_swee: His big claw goes out wide to his right and sweeps low across the ground in front of him.
A front leg lifts high and stabs its pointed foot down at you.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.grapeshot: One gun runs out and fires a spray of small shot at close range. Needs a gun on him.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.claw_clam: His big claw grabs it, lifts it up, squeezes and throws it. Hit the claw three times to get free. Never a giant.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.feeler_gr: A feeler wraps round it and drags it to his mouth, and he bites. Hit the feeler three times to get free. Never a giant.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.cannon_br: He turns a side to it and the guns fire one after another. One shot for each gun still on him.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.burrow.wh: He sinks into the sand or the sea bed, goes along under the ground and bursts up under it.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.gaze.what: Every eye opens wide and glows. Whoever looks him in the eye gets sick and slow.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.claw_hamm: He shuts his big claw like a fist, raises it high and hammers it down. The ground shakes out round it.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.leg_flurr: Both front legs stab fast, one after the other, as he walks in on you.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.scuttle_c: He crouches, then rushes sideways like a crab and rams everything in the way.
The ship on his back swings away, then swings back as he lunges: the bow and bowsprit ram you.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.barnacle_: His ship heaves and throws barnacle clusters high out of its hatches. They burst into spiky crust that slows and hurts whoever stands in it.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.kelp_snar: Kelp from his hull lashes out and roots you to the spot for a few seconds. You can't walk or jump.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.silt_clou: He churns up the sand (ink under water). Anyone in the cloud is blinded, and mobs lose track of him.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.drowned_c: His hold opens and his dead crew climb out to fight for him. A few at most. They fall apart after a minute.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.ships_bel: The bell on his stern tolls three times. Each toll stuns everyone round him.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.anchor_sw: He swings the great anchor round him on its chain, low over the ground, then throws it down on you and drags it back.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.mast_swee: He rolls his ship over on its side and sweeps the mainmast across the ground.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.tide_pull: Only near water. The sea draws back toward him, he rears up and slams down, and a wave rolls out all round.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.shell_sla: He rears up on his back legs and drops the whole wreck down: a shockwave runs out along the ground.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.pincer_cr: Both claws open wide and rise up either side of you, then slam together. A huge hit and a shockwave.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.cannon_ba: Every gun runs out. His left side fires down its whole length twice, then his right side. Needs guns.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.feeler_st: Every feeler rears up over his deck, then they all come down round him, twice.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.whirlpool: Only in water. He spins and the sea turns with him, pulling swimmers and boats in.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.tidal_wav: Sea move. He rears up out of the sea and slams down. A wall of water rolls out, over the shore too, and carries everything with it.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.deeps_gra: Sea move. Every feeler shoots out under the water, grabs whoever is swimming or in a boat, and holds them down on the sea floor by his mouth. Hit the feeler to get free.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.full_broa: Sea move. He turns side on like a warship and every gun on that side fires, both gun decks, three volleys.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.maelstrom: Sea move. A huge whirlpool for 15 seconds. It pulls everything to the middle, where his claws snap.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.depth_cha: Sea move. He drives his big claw into the sea floor. A shockwave goes through the water, hurting and stunning everything in it. Fish die.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.storm_cal: Sea move. The sky goes dark and it rains for 40 seconds. Lightning strikes at anyone in or on the water near him.
guide.jj_giants.wreckback.move.riptide_c: Sea move. He sinks under, charges along the sea floor and bursts up right under you, throwing everything into the air.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.name: The Swarmforge
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.size: About 225 blocks long, 142 wide and 152 tall at full size, the biggest giant. 4,000 health.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.2: A huge rusted war factory on four tank treads. Six hangar doors, two crane arms on the roof, a scrap cannon, a caged glowing core and four chimneys.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.3: He's the factory: he isn't that strong on his own, but he keeps sending out robots. His army is the danger.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.4: He drives like a tank and right through trees, about 4 blocks a second at full size. You can climb him: his walls are solid, you can stand on his roof and catwalks, and a boarding ladder goes up his back.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.5: All of him is solid, and so are his big robots (the siege mech, the heavy walker, the brute, a landed pod). You can stand on any of them and ride along as they drive, walk and turn. Nothing ends up inside him: you, mobs and dropped things are put out beside him unhurt. What a big robot walks into is pushed, never trapped.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.6: Giants don't go through him. When he meets another giant his body stops at its side, he drives up to its side, not its middle, and his blows land on its side.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.7: When it's quiet he powers down: engine off, lights dim, cranes folded. A hit, an order or somebody climbing into his cab wakes him.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.9: | Calm | leaves you alone unless you hit him
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.10: | Hunting | goes after any player he can find, and hostile mobs too
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.11: | Guardian | stays near where he was put down and goes after anything that comes near it
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.12: Spawn eggs (creative): the Swarmforge, Small, Calm, Hunting and Guardian, and one for each robot and unit.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.about.13: He heals very slowly on his own: 1% of his health a minute, and nothing for 15 seconds after any hurt, so in a fight it hardly counts.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.where.2: His own biome. In the middle is his yard: flat concrete with a yellow and black edge and lamp posts. Round it are the scrap fields: heaps of scrap, wrecked robots, old pylons, glowing slag pools and stacks of crates. No trees, no water, no villages.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.where.3: Its own blocks: Scrap Heap, Rusted Plate, Hazard Plate, Oily Dirt and glowing Slag.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.where.4: There is one in a world, 3,000 to 15,000 blocks from spawn. /locate biome swarmforge:scrapyard finds it.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.where.6: Make a Finder of the Swarmforge and right-click it. It says in chat which way he is and how far. It glints while he is within 300 blocks.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.where.9: | Natural spawning | On to start with. The world keeps one of him in his Scrapyard. /swarmforge natural off stops it.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.where.10: | How many at once | 1 to start with (the world cap). /swarmforge limit changes it, 0 for no limit. Past it, the oldest one goes.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.where.11: | After he dies | The next one rolls out about 10 days later, in a new Scrapyard.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.moves.1: His own attacks come from his cannon, his cranes, his furnace and his treads. His unit moves send out robots: the alarm, the spotlight, the rally and the overclock work his army, the rest send out units of their own. Crane moves stop once both crane arms are broken, and the cannon moves once the cannon is.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.1: In a fight, about every 20 seconds his lights flash red, the hangar doors still on him drop open and a wave of robots rolls out. The worse he is hurt, the bigger and sooner the waves. Fewer doors, fewer robots. With no doors left, no more waves.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.2: Every robot costs army points: small ones less, big strong ones more (a swarm drone 1, a walker 2, a brute 8, a siege mech 40). His robots out never cost more than his army points together (150, set by command or in his settings). A robot that dies or is recycled frees its points at once. His waves are a mix of what the points left pay for. When he goes out of the world (nobody near), his robots go with him and come back round him when he does. When he dies, every robot of his shuts down and falls apart.

guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.5: @item swarmforge:flyer_spawn_egg | Flyer | A little drone. Circles over you and shoots sparks.

guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.9: @item swarmforge:shield_bearer_spawn_egg | Shield bearer | Walks behind a tall shield. Get round its side.

guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.22: @item swarmforge:sniper_spawn_egg | Sniper | A red beam shows where it aims for two seconds, then it hits hard. Get out of its sight.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.23: @item swarmforge:mortar_spawn_egg | Mortar crawler | Lobs shells over walls. It doesn't need to see you.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.24: @item swarmforge:builder_spawn_egg,swarmforge:barricade_spawn_egg | Builder | Hammers up barricades between you and him. His robots can walk through them, you can't.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.26: Hold his book and his robots are yours too. His book is simple: Orders has come, go there, hold still, ride, his target and a big Commander Mode button. Army has Stow all (or Release all), Auto-stow, Commander Mode and the Build grid: every robot type as a big icon with its cost in points.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.27: In the Build grid, click a type to queue one, right click to take its last one out (its points come back). Orders by type, groups, the rally point, formations, recycling and which types his own waves bring are all in Commander Mode.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.29: Click a type as often as you like, in the book, in Commander Mode or with a build key: each click queues one. Its points are held at once. If they aren't free yet it waits in the queue, marked "pts". He builds up to six at once, one in each bay, and only the door of that bay drops open.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.30: | Points | 150 to start with. Over the book's tabs: robots out, points used and held, points free.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.31: | The queue | icons with a bar on each one building, in the book, in Commander Mode and on the driving screen. Right click one to take it out.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.32: | Commands | /swarmforge army queue lists it, /swarmforge army queue clear empties it
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.34: A wide ramp swings down from under his tail. His robots near him march up it and turn into data at the top: a scan line, glowing pixels, a flash. He keeps them inside, by type and health, and brings them back out the same way. If he dies, the stored ones spill out as scrap.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.35: Auto-stow is off to start with: he only stows them when you say. Turn it on and he stows them himself when he's calm and it's been quiet a while, and says so in chat. Hunting or guarding, he lets them out the moment there's trouble.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.36: Recycled robots go up the same ramp and are broken down at the top with sparks and a grinding: all their points are free again at once.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.37: | Book | Army: Stow all / Release all, Auto-stow on or off
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.38: | Commander Mode | Stow, and R twice recycles the robots you picked
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.39: | His cab | O stows or releases, L has a claw set you down on the ground beside him, Y and I build one robot of a type
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.40: | Commands | /swarmforge army stow, release, recycle [type|all], autostow on/off, /swarmforge build <type> [count]
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.42: Leave your body and command his army from above, like a strategy game. Your body stays where it was, safe. You fly a camera anywhere he's loaded, with no 750 block limit: it stops at land that isn't loaded and can't go through blocks or into him. He keeps fighting on his own, and he and all his robots stay put while you command. Only for a player he's friendly to, one at a time. F1 shows every key.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.43: | Get in | the book's Commander Mode button, P in his cab, or /swarmforge commander
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.44: | Look round | put the cursor against an edge of the screen: left and right turn, top and bottom tilt. Or hold the right or middle mouse button and move it, Tab for mouse-look, Q/E to turn round the middle, Up/Down to tilt, T for straight down, Backspace to reset, J back to him
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.45: | Select | click, drag a box, double click for every robot of that type, Ctrl+A all, I the idle ones, Ctrl+1-9 saves a group, 1-9 picks it (twice: fly to it)
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.46: | Orders | right click: move (Shift: more spots), attack, come back; M move, X attack-move, Z patrol, H hold, Y stop, G guard, R twice recycle, L rally point, N ping, F formation
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.47: | Build | the build bar: each type with its cost, click queues one, right click takes one out, Shift+click: in his waves or not. B+1-9 or your own keys. His unit moves are a row of icons
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.48: | Get out | P. Esc only lets go of what you have in hand. It ends by itself only for a real reason, said in chat: he died, was put to sleep, is gone, turned on you, or something attacked your body.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.50: Pick one robot and press C (or Drive on its card). A banner says which one you took, a frame edges your view, and it glows for everyone. F5 changes between its eyes and behind it, and it remembers which.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.51: | Keys | WASD walks it (flyers fly where you look), Space jumps, the mouse aims, left click attacks, right click its ability
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.52: | Its screen | its health, what your buttons do and when its attack is ready, how far and how well he is, and his build queue
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.army.53: | Back | C to the camera, P to your body. If it's destroyed, "Lost control" and you're back at the camera.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.fight.2: - Break the six hangar doors. Each one gone means fewer robots.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.fight.3: - Break the two crane arms. That stops his crane moves.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.fight.4: - With all the doors and both arms gone, the cage round his core swings open. Hit the core.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.fight.7: | The core, cage shut | a fifth.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.fight.9: | Doors, crane arms, the cannon | half, and it wears that piece down.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.fight.12: - Kill the repair bots and shield drones first, then the rest of the wave.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.fight.13: - Keep moving away from where his cannon is pointing, and out of a sniper's red beam.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.fight.14: - When the red message comes up, get away. Right after a heavy move he is worn out: hit him then.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.drops.1: His loot goes into a Loot Cache on a little scrap altar where he falls. Its beam shows from far off.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.drops.2: @item swarmforge:wrench_hammer |  | His weapon. Hits hard and knocks things dizzy. Right-click and three of his walker robots drop down and fight for you for 30 seconds.

guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.drops.4: | Armour power (R) | Overdrive: for 8 seconds you and your helper are faster and stronger and dig quicker. Every 30 seconds.

guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.drops.6: @item swarmforge:forge_plate | And more | Forge Plates, iron, copper, redstone and gold, netherite scrap and diamonds.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.drops.7: @item swarmforge:swarmforge_codex |  | His book. Hold it and he is yours: he leaves you alone, drives where you point, and his robots take your orders.

A part of another giant counts as that giant. Only you see it glow. If he won't go, it says why.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.2: | /swarmforge where | where every one is, in the world or out of it
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.3: | /swarmforge detail on/off | draw him simpler far away (your own game only)
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.4: | /swarmforge detail far <blocks> | how far off you see him on the skyline
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.5: | /swarmforge commander | Commander Mode with the nearest one, if he's friendly to you (again: back to your body)
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.7: | /swarmforge summon [calm/hunting/guardian] [size] | makes one in front of you
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.8: | /swarmforge do <move> | he does that move now (it says why if he can't)
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.9: | /swarmforge wave | he sends out a wave of robots now
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.10: | /swarmforge come [player] | he comes to you, from any distance
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.11: | /swarmforge carry | he comes and lifts you into his cab
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.14: | /swarmforge sleep / wake | puts him to sleep, or wakes him
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.15: | /swarmforge natural on/off | whether one of him lives out in the world

guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.19: | /swarmforge powers reset | the armour's power and the hammer are ready again
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.commands.21: | /swarmforge paint [radius] [full/biome] [depth] | turns the land round you into the Scrapyard. It can't be undone.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.scrap_ca: The barrel swings round and fires a ball of scrap in an arc. Twice when he is angry.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.smoke_sc: The chimneys pour out thick smoke. Hard to see through, and his robots in it are hidden.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.spotligh: His headlights lock on one creature, and every robot goes for it.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.rally.wh: His robots pull back round him to guard him, then they all charge.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.mine_lay: A mine layer rolls out of a bay and lays a line of mines.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.repair_b: A repair bot rolls out of a bay and welds his hurt robots back together.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.barricad: Two builders run out and throw up barricades across the way to him.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.tread_cr: He revs and charges to run it over.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.crane_sw: A crane arm draws back and sweeps low across the ground.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.crane_gr: A crane claw grabs it, holds it up and throws it. Hit the arm three times to get free. Never a giant.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.alarm.wh: Sirens: an extra wave of robots right away.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.paratroo: His cannon fires a pod far out. It lands behind its target and a squad steps out. Needs the cannon.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.drone_sw: A cloud of drones pours out of his chimneys at one target.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.deploy_t: A crane arm sets a scrap turret down beside him. Needs a crane arm.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.shield_d: A shield drone rolls out of a bay. His robots under its bubble take a third of each hit.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.drill_bo: Three drill bots roll out, tunnel under the ground and burst up under their target.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.sniper.w: A sniper walks out of a bay. It stays far back and fires one hard shot after a red beam.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.mortar_c: Two mortar crawlers come out and lob shells over cover.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.crane_sl: A crane arm rears up high and smashes down with a shockwave.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.furnace_: The grill on his face drops open and fire blasts out in front of him.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.ram_char: He revs up and rams whatever is in front of him.
guide.jj_giants.swarmforge.move.overcloc: His core flares. All his robots are faster and stronger for a while.
